question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of electricity transmission and distribution lines in Spain, with voltage level, operator and status?

answer.summary: No open official Spanish dataset provides all transmission and distribution line routes with exact voltage, operator and status. Nationally, IGN Base Topográfica Nacional (BTN 0710L_LIN_ELEC via vt-btn.idee.es MVT API or CNIG GeoPackage) gives overhead routes and banded voltages (<100, 100-150, 220, 400 kV), excluding underground/submarine cables, operator and status. Official operator and exact >=50 kV voltage exist for Andalucía (MIEA WFS) and transmission status appears in schematic MITECO 2025-2030 PDFs; REE Infored (request form) and Inkolan (paid DWG) hold operator plans, while OpenStreetMap/OpenInfraMap partially covers all fields nationally.
main_caveats: IGN BTN 0710L_LIN_ELEC excludes all underground and submarine cables (lines stop at transition towers) and omits operator and status fields.
CNMC Circular 6/2025 access-capacity maps publish substation point nodes only, not line routes; none of Spain's 325 active DSOs publish open line-route GIS.
CNIG Centro de Descargas (BTN_T_Energia GeoPackage) drops automated HTTP requests (empty reply); programmatic access works via IGN/IDEE MVT tiles at vt-btn.idee.es.
ENTSO-E Grid Map explicitly warns elements are not at exact geographic coordinates; REE public GeoRED MapServer exposes only 63 sample circuits.
OpenStreetMap/OpenInfraMap maps 128,460 km in Spain (2026-11-15), but 19.5% lacks voltage tags and ~85% of lines in Madrid/Granada samples lack operator tags.
answer.confidence_reason: Verified official regulator, ministry, TSO, IGN/IDEE, regional WFS, ENTSO-E, OSM/OpenInfraMap, and Inkolan endpoints directly with live queries and file downloads.

attributes.gap_note: The original rows have different scopes. Their combination has not been established as complete; original rows are retained in internal curation.

attributes.note: IGN BTN uses 4 bands (<100, 100-150, 220, 400 kV); Andalucía MIEA gives exact kV (>=50 kV); OSM has exact voltage on 80.5% of mapped length; ENTSO-E/MITECO cover >=132 kV.
attributes.gap_note: No open national source gives exact kV for all distribution tiers (<100 kV); IGN BTN groups all lines below 100 kV and 100-150 kV into coarse bands.

attributes.note: IGN BTN and ENTSO-E lack operator; Andalucía MIEA gives PROPIETARIO (>=50 kV); REE is statutory sole TSO; OSM tags operator on ~14% in samples; Inkolan organizes by partner DSO.
attributes.gap_note: Outside Andalucía (>=50 kV) and statutory TSO REE, open GIS datasets lack distribution operator names across Spain's 325 active DSOs.

attributes.note: IGN BTN and Andalucía MIEA lack status; MITECO 2025-2030 PDF shows existing/planned/retired schematically; ENTSO-E marks Under Construction; OSM tags construction.
attributes.gap_note: No open national GIS vector dataset tracks operational status for both transmission and distribution lines; distribution status is unpublished as open GIS.
